step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard shows Taco Bell's Order Middleware serverless architecture for handling delivery aggregator orders. 1. Customer and Driver mobile interactions send events to the Delivery Aggregator (ThirdParty). 2. Delivery Aggregator sends order events to AWS API Gateway. 3. API Gateway forwards events via direct service integration to EventBridge. 4. EventBridge triggers AWS Step Functions. 5. Step Functions executes Lambda functions. 6. Lambda sends confirmation events back to Delivery Aggregator and releases orders to Taco Bell store technology.

edges.notes: Customer places order on delivery aggregator app
Driver accepts order and sends location geofence events
Delivery aggregator posts event to API Gateway
API Gateway forwards event directly to EventBridge
EventBridge triggers Step Functions state machine execution
Lambda notifies Delivery Aggregator that order is accepted
Lambda triggers store kitchen/POS system to prepare food
